name: Generative NeRF-to-NeRF Translation
definition: A unified NeRF-to-NeRF translation framework that lifts 2D image edits to 3D by modeling the distribution of edited NeRFs via a conditional generative model, enabling text-driven editing, colorization, super-resolution, and inpainting.
summary: Generative NeRF-to-NeRF Translation lifts 2D image edits to 3D by learning a latent distribution of edited NeRFs to ensure multi-view consistency across various editing tasks.
